build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: All hosts use __now(). Native before/after rebuilt with identical console-only steady_clock patch. Sub-millisecond monotonic clock checks pass. Historical native timings used Date.now fallback; low-percent differences should be assessed within this paired run.
order: Three complete 33-case overlap invocations plus canonical and isolated Locale controls per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 342 values checked (297 overlap, 27 canonical tag controls, 18 isolated Locale controls). All FormatJS before/after values match; all controls match all hosts. Only overlap comparator differences: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Retain private enum/increment tables, call captured canonicalization directly, bind WeakMap setter once, and serialize validated ASCII/integer options directly without a temporary record or JSON.stringify. Omit undefined digit fields.

conformance.gates: Five focused gates pass: Hermes plural source/optimized-bytecode conformance; PluralRules Test262; Chromium source/bytecode matrix; pinned ICU4C/J and ICU4X comparisons.
conformance.observableBehavior: Preserves getter/coercion order, deferred digit validation and omitted-option defaults. Existing intrinsic-poisoning tests now also replace Function.prototype.bind after installation.
conformance.consumer: Nine SDK API smoke scripts pass.

timingChange: Every host pinned to CPU 0 for this complete comparison. Historical tables used unpinned processes; assess code effects within this paired run.
profileNote: Fresh before/after profiles from the exact optimized SDK hosts, pinned to CPU 0. No profiling or builds during timings.
limits: Several constructor and steady-state gaps remain. No whole-goal completion claim.

commands.benchmark: Build SDK and all three optimized workloads with Bazel; apply native-clock.patch to pinned standalone console host and rebuild both native variants with CMake; run each cquery workload on each optimized host pinned to CPU0.

rustNote: Rust crates tree byte-identical before/after; constructor changes only affect Hermes facade and tests.
